LESSON: BULLYING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living Today
Topic 6.4: Bullying

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Bullying
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How did it affect your self-esteem?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify causes of bullying at school and in the community
2. model the value of love in their interaction with others

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify causes of bullying at school and in the community

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify causes of bullying at school and in the community.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify causes of bullying at school and in the community” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify causes of bullying at school and in the community” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify causes of bullying at school and in the community" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: model the value of love in their interaction with others

Teach
• Today’s focus: model the value of love in their interaction with others.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “model the value of love in their interaction with others” using a school example.
• Model B for “model the value of love in their interaction with others” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "model the value of love in their interaction with others" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify causes of bullying at school and in the community
• Model 2: model the value of love in their interaction with others

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify causes of bullying at school and in the community
2. Practise: model the value of love in their interaction with others

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Bullying.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did it affect your self-esteem?
2. how the values you have listed can enhance peaceful co-existence, Why is bullying unacceptable?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify causes of bullying at school and in the community
• model the value of love in their interaction with others

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
